Hi Brad. I've checked Priya and Marcus's calendars. Here are the times when BOTH they are free for 30 minutes next week:

- Monday: 9:00-10:00
- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday: 15:00-16:00
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30, 14:30-15:00
- Friday: 11:00-12:00

Please check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars to see when they're free during these slots. Let me know which slots work for all four partners. I recommend we try Monday 9:00 or Tuesday 13:00 first as they have the most flexibility.
